metrics.summary: Fixed the help hint in usage errors in `src/click/exceptions.py` (`UsageError.show`). It previously used `ctx.help_option_names[0]` (the raw configured list, e.g. `-h`), even when the command had taken that name over with its own option. Now it uses `ctx.command.get_help_option_names(ctx)` — the names actually usable as the command's help option (already filtered against the command's own options) — and suggests the longest of those (so `--help` over `-h`). If no help option name works, the hint line is omitted entirely, matching the existing `get_help_option is None` guard. Added a regression test `test_formatting_usage_error_help_option_name_taken` in tests/test_formatting.py covering: `-h` taken → suggests `--help`; all names taken → no hint. Full test suite (excluding slow shell-completion parametrized tests) passes: 1385 passed, 23 skipped, 1 xfailed.
